evidenceChecks.observed: Augments a magic item with a new random modifier
Magic items can have up to two random modifiers

No currency weight formula is in the item text. PoB's spawn-weight walk is not an Augmentation sampler.

Empty-pool and full-item outcomes are not stated.

PoB separates defence families that this snapshot groups as BaseLocalDefences. Groups are not used as Augmentation exclusions.
